meta.name: V4 Experiment Matrix Spec
meta.objective: Specify a self-contained V4 paper program and final experiment matrix for judge-gym, grounded in pilots, literature-audit targets, and multi-provider runtime constraints.

knownTools: Anthropic direct and native batch support
knownConstraints: V4 must be a self-contained paper study, not a pilot continuation.
OpenAI remains the primary model family and baseline reference line.
Wave-1 provider expansion is limited to Anthropic and OpenRouter; Gemini and Grok are deferred.
The final matrix should privilege matched contrasts over a large full-factorial sweep.
The live repo is greenfield V4: evidence universes, evidence sets, source records, semantic views, and transform runs are available now.
Historical V3 findings constrain claim selection: abstention, concept framing, model placement, and grouping are first-order levers; l3 is weaker.
Paper-audit targets must remain fair reconstructions rather than bespoke reinterpretations.
unknowns: Whether the launch bundle should include Zheng or Thakur as the comparator lane.
Which exact Ziems subset should be precommitted for V4.
Which OpenRouter-backed model family should anchor the third provider slice.
How much of the perturbation sweep should be identical across all targets versus target-specific.
notes: Relevant grounding lives in docs/pilots plus prior V4 blueprints under _blueprints/ and _deep_workflows/.
Current codebase already supports Media Cloud-first acquisition, source-record versus semantic-view separation, and provider-aware runtime routing.

objectiveModel.terminalObjective: Specify a self-contained V4 paper program and final experiment matrix for judge-gym, grounded in pilots, literature-audit targets, and multi-provider runtime constraints.
successCriteria: Lock a launch-bundle target set with explicit roles in the paper argument.
Define a final V4 experiment matrix that is self-contained, bounded, and publishable.
Specify a provider panel policy with OpenAI primary plus Anthropic and OpenRouter wave-1 controls.
Specify evidence-set quality rules, source-record versus semantic-view usage rules, and transform requirements.
Define primary endpoints and sanity checks consistent with the geometry-first pilot framing.
Produce a bounded deep-workflow request for the next compilation step toward the final matrix package.
nonGoals: Do not expand wave 1 to Gemini, Grok, or broad many-provider claims.
Do not treat V4 as a general literature census or a full systematic review.
Do not promise human-ground-truth validity claims beyond evaluator-regime auditing.
Do not let engine generalization reopen the already-settled greenfield evidence/runtime architecture.
dependencyPolicy: Use docs/pilots as the highest-priority scientific continuity source.
Use prior V4 blueprint artifacts as secondary planning evidence rather than re-deriving earlier research.
Treat current repo runtime and schema state as the implementation source of truth for what V4 can support now.
Promote only study designs that are supportable by the current engine or require narrow, explicit deltas.

capabilityTiers.label: Matrix-ready specification
capabilityTiers.definition: Final launch bundle, perturbation families, provider panel, evidence/view contract, and endpoints are all locked in writing.

capabilityTiers.label: Workflow-compilable package
capabilityTiers.definition: A bounded deep-workflow request can compile the final matrix package without reopening core study-design questions.

capabilityTiers.label: Execution-ready V4 study
capabilityTiers.definition: The spec cleanly maps onto the current engine substrate, with only target-specific import work left.

baselinePlan: Start from the strongest stable pilot claims: abstention, concept framing, model placement, and grouping are primary levers; l3 is secondary.
Start from the highest-certainty target bundle research: Gilardi primary, Ziems subset secondary, Zheng default comparator, Thakur alternate, Santurkar deferred.
Treat OpenAI as the baseline continuity family, then add Anthropic and OpenRouter as symmetric controls rather than equal first-pass optimization targets.
progressionLadder: environment discovery -> integrate pilots, target-viability research, and live repo capabilities
launch-bundle lock -> finalize target roles and comparator/default decisions
matrix compilation -> define perturbation families, provider slices, evidence/view rules, and endpoints
paper packaging -> turn the matrix into a final self-contained study specification with deliverables

searchRegimes.focus: Use the pilot results and prior V4 research to narrow the paper to the strongest defensible claim surface.
Test whether provider expansion and paper-audit targets materially change the recommended matrix shape.

pruneRules: Prune any branch that turns V4 into a broad platform manifesto instead of a paper-ready study.
Prune candidate targets that require large new execution machinery or lack fair reconstruction support.
Prune perturbation families that do not connect back to strong V2/V3 findings or externally legible audit claims.
escalationRules: Escalate to a deeper workflow only after the workspace resolves the current strategic bottleneck into a bounded spec question.
Escalate provider breadth only after the OpenAI + Anthropic + OpenRouter panel is coherently specified.
Escalate beyond the launch bundle only after the core V4 paper argument is stable.
promotionRules: Promote a matrix design only if it preserves geometry-first claims, is bounded enough to execute, and keeps provider symmetry legible.
Promote a target bundle only if each chosen target has a distinct argumentative role and acceptable reconstruction fairness.
Promote a workflow request only if it is concrete enough to compile without reopening campaign-level decisions.

reviewRequired: Changing the launch bundle after it is locked
Expanding the provider panel beyond OpenAI, Anthropic, and OpenRouter
Turning the study into a full-factorial matrix
stopConditions: Terminal objective met: final V4 study specification and matrix are locked.
Hard blocker: a required top target loses reconstructability or provider panel policy becomes unsupported.

budget.primaryCostControl: Prefer planning and specification over live external runs.
budget.executionScope: Compile one bounded workflow at a time.
